rules.why: A backlog-exhaustion flood leaves connections half-open: the TCP state stays SYN-received, so serror_rate approaches 1 while the connection count to one host exceeds 100.

features.meaning: count / (duration + 1). Connection attempt rate to the same host, the primary flood signal.
Counts of connections to the same host/service in the trailing 2-second window are the primary signal for scanning and flooding.
